sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A bulbous perennial of western North America, found in southwestern Oregon and northern California. It grows in dry woods and brushy slopes, often on serpentine soils.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: Its two leaves, 9–15 cm long, are often mottled. A 12–35 cm stalk bears one to three cream or pinkish flowers, usually yellow at the base; the capsule is 2–5 cm long.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: The sources consulted do not establish food use or species-specific toxicity.
